## Description {#details}

<p>Wraps a BPI to allow lazy computation of the branch probabilities.</p>


<p>A pass that only conditionally uses BPI can uncondtionally require the analysis without paying for the overhead if BPI doesn't end up being used.</p>


<p>Definition at line 55 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/analysis/lazybranchprobabilityinfo-h">LazyBranchProbabilityInfo.h</a>.</p>
